# What is data privacy?

- Somewhat hard to define
- Nissenbaum's concept (shortly and easy)

In this tutorial, I will use the term data protection. Privacy is a larger term, encompassing values, attitudes, and behaviors, while data protection is more technical and closer to actual mechanisms.

## Why is data protection important?

Some personal reflection tasks

As researchers, our obligation to data protection arises from two (not totally distinct) directions: ethics and law.
